name: pdk-plane-reliable-work-item-events-v3
instr:
# Reliable work-item history and webhooks

Changes made through Plane's public `/api/v1/` work-item create, PATCH, and delete endpoints can commit before their activity and webhook messages are published. A broker outage leaves successful changes without history, while restarted workers and receiver retries can duplicate or reorder deliveries. Make each committed change appear once in the existing work-item activity API, in commit order per item, and reach each active issue webhook in the same order. Failed or rolled-back writes must produce neither activity nor deliveries. In particular, the public work-item `/activities/` result must contain one `created` activity for creation, each committed `name` revision exactly once and in order (including PATCH updates through either API alias), and one `deleted` activity for deletion; a rejected invalid update must add no activity or webhook.

Writes must succeed while RabbitMQ is offline for up to two minutes; their activity and webhook deliveries must catch up within two minutes of recovery. A worker killed mid-burst, two API instances, and two workers must not lose, duplicate, or reorder changes to the same item. Retry failed webhook calls until a 2xx; retries must retain the same `X-Plane-Delivery` id, expose the strictly increasing per-item sequence in an `X-Plane-Sequence` header, and begin within 30 seconds of the receiver's recovery.
